verses.english: “Mendicants, the conditioned has these three characteristics.

verses.pali: Uppādo paññāyati, vayo paññāyati, ṭhitassa aññathattaṁ paññāyati.
verses.english: Arising is evident, vanishing is evident, and change while persisting is evident.

verses.pali: Imāni kho, bhikkhave, tīṇi saṅkhatassa saṅkhatalakkhaṇānī”ti.
verses.english: These are the three characteristics of the conditioned.”

verses.pali: Na uppādo paññāyati, na vayo paññāyati, na ṭhitassa aññathattaṁ paññāyati.
verses.english: No arising is evident, no vanishing is evident, and no change while persisting is evident.

verses.pali: Imāni kho, bhikkhave, tīṇi asaṅkhatassa asaṅkhatalakkhaṇānī”ti.
verses.english: These are the three characteristics of the unconditioned.”
